person_confirmed_available_after_rescue_.logic: If permanentlyUnavailable true, block; if actual current availability is confirmed for requested date, pass; otherwise require known rescue completed before visit. Unknown rescue with no present observation remains unknown, never infer death. Future rescue completion may be an explicit conditional action outcome, never inferred from highest floor.
person_confirmed_available_after_rescue_.historyPolicy: Present observation can establish availability without reconstructing prior actions

sourceEvidence.locator: Hierophant disappearance09-12; Hanged Man disappearance10-21; rescue failure ends progression

applicableGuardResolution: For a validated unlocked normal rank1-9 checkpoint, no applicable unresolved person-specific guard plus no explicit current/date unavailable override satisfies entity-specific eligibility in conditional mode. Do not create hundreds of future knownUnavailable=false facts. Rescue guards apply only to their two entities after stated boundary; rank-scene/romance flags remain separate.
